motionDesc.cross: crosses the center to the other side of the formation
motionDesc.enter: moves in toward the center but does not cross

man.title: Man coverage
man.text: A defender went with {who} when he moved. A defender following the motion man means man coverage. Attack with crossers and picks. Know your man-beater routes, and QB, read the matchup.

zone.title: Zone coverage
zone.text: Nobody followed {who}. The defense stayed in its zones and adjusted. No follower means zone, so find the soft spot.

idle.noDefense: Turn on a defense to see how it reacts to this play and where the open window is.
idle.noRoutes: No routes yet. Tap a receiver, then pick a route.
idle.motion: Watch the motion. Does a defender follow?
idle.play: Watch the play. The read shows up at the end.

train.readQuestion: A receiver goes in motion. Did a defender go with him? Man or zone?
train.manHint: Man: each defender covers one player.
train.zoneHint: Zone: each defender covers an area.
train.beatIntro: Build a play that gets a receiver open. Give every receiver a route, then tap Grade my play.
train.beatNotComplete: Give every receiver a route first.
train.beatCovered: Covered! No one was open enough. Change a route or add motion and grade it again.

summary.0: Keep practicing. You will get it!

covered: {defense} has a defender within {sep} yards of every receiver. Change a route or add motion to make space.
